    """Login to Fedex Delivery Manager."""
    session.visit(LOGIN_URL)

    username = session.find(id='username')
    password = session.find(id='password')
    submit = session.find(id='login')

    username.fill(USERNAME)
    password.fill(PASSWORD)
    submit.click()

    session.find(id='logout').click()

    session.visit(LOGIN_URL)

    username.fill(USERNAME)
    password.fill(PASSWORD)
    submit.click()

def _logout(session):
    """Logout from Fedex Delivery Manager."""
    session.visit(LOGIN_URL)

    session.find(id='logout').click()


def _get_tracking_code(session):
    """Get tracking code from Fedex Delivery Manager."""
    session.visit(TRACKING_URL)

    session.find(id='trackingNumber').fill(TRACKING_NUMBER)
    session.find(id='track').click()

    # Wait for tracking number to be displayed
    session.wait(lambda: session.find(text=TRACKING_NUMBER).visible)

    return session.find(text=TRACKING_NUMBER).parent.find('a').text


def _get_tracking_status(session):
    """Get tracking status from Fedex Delivery Manager."""
    session.visit(TRACKING_URL)

    session.find(id='trackingNumber').fill(TRACKING_NUMBER)
    session.find(id='track').click()

    # Wait for tracking number to be displayed
    session.wait(lambda: session.find(text=TRACKING_NUMBER).visible)

    return session.find(text=TRACKING_NUMBER).parent.find('span').text


def _get_tracking_info(session):
    """Get tracking info from Fedex Delivery Manager."""
    session.visit(TRACKING_URL)

    session.find(id='trackingNumber').fill(TRACKING_NUMBER)
    session.find(id='track').click()
